project: CareLoop - Abu Dhabi Closed-Loop Screening-to-Care Platform

syntheticDataNotice.statement: All patient records and clinical identifiers in CareLoop are synthetic, generated deterministically by our internal seed script with a fixed random seed (seed = 42). They contain zero real personal health information (PHI).

sources.title: Multicomponent EHR-Based Outreach and Navigation for Diagnostic Resolution Following Abnormal Screening
sources.population: US community health centers primary care cohort
sources.empiricalFinding: 22.9% resolution in usual care vs 31.4% with EHR reminders + active navigation at 120 days
sources.careLoopParameterUsage: Baseline follow-up rate without navigation vs boosted completion when multi-channel navigator intervention triggers
sources.limitation: Conducted in US healthcare safety net with high underinsured proportion; does not fully reflect UAE insurance mandate.

sources.title: Mobile Phone Text Messaging to Improve Follow-Up After Screening: A Randomized Controlled Trial
sources.population: Sub-Saharan Africa primary screening clinics in Tanzania
sources.empiricalFinding: 24.0% attendance in SMS arm vs 23.8% in control arm
sources.careLoopParameterUsage: Validates why single SMS reminders alone have ~24% acknowledgement rate and do not drive follow-up without active escalation
sources.limitation: Rural East African low-resource setting with basic mobile feature phones; differs from UAE smartphone/broadband landscape.

sources.title: Interactive Telephone Navigation versus Routine Notification for Diagnostic Follow-Up: A Randomized Trial
sources.population: Cameroon urban and semi-urban screening facilities
sources.empiricalFinding: 25.6% diagnostic resolution in telephone navigation arm vs 6.1% in standard care
sources.careLoopParameterUsage: Calibrates step-up efficacy parameter when escalation shifts from automated SMS to voice telephone outreach
sources.limitation: Conducted in low-resource standard-of-care baseline where standard follow-up was extremely low (6.1%).

sources.title: Effectiveness of Single vs Multicomponent Interventions for Timely Follow-up of Abnormal Cancer Screening: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
sources.population: Global multi-country pooled cohort of abnormal screening follow-ups
sources.empiricalFinding: Multicomponent outreach OR = 3.01 (95% CI 2.45-3.70) vs single-modality outreach OR = 1.56
sources.careLoopParameterUsage: Parameterizes the multi-tier escalation ladder efficacy multiplier in CareLoop simulation engine
sources.limitation: Heterogeneity in intervention duration and varied definitions of abnormal screening results across countries.

sources.title: Follow-up Colonoscopy Completion After Positive Fecal Immunochemical Test in Organized vs Opportunistic Screening Programmes
sources.empiricalFinding: Mean 79% follow-up colonoscopy within 6 months (range 39-100%); organised programmes 81% vs opportunistic 57%
sources.careLoopParameterUsage: Defines benchmark targets for referral completion and diagnostic colonoscopy completion rates
sources.limitation: Endoscopy facility availability and clinical waiting lists vary widely between jurisdictions.

sources.title: Retrospective Review of Colorectal Cancer Screening and Diagnostic Follow-Up Among UAE Nationals in Abu Dhabi
sources.population: Emirati citizens aged 40-75 in Abu Dhabi ambulatory care clinics
sources.empiricalFinding: 23.5% screening FOBT uptake; 13.5% follow-up colonoscopy completion among positives
sources.careLoopParameterUsage: Historical Abu Dhabi baseline showing severe follow-up drop-off in the absence of active digital closed-loop tracking
sources.limitation: Old historical record (2015-2016) restricted to Emirati national cohort prior to Malaffi HIE deployment.

assumptions.name: Language Alignment Uplift
assumptions.value: 18% penalty if notification language mismatches patient preferred language
assumptions.rationale: Empirical health communication literature indicates comprehension drop-offs when health alerts are delivered in a secondary language.

assumptions.name: Arabic RTL Comprehension Gain
assumptions.value: 15% increase in understanding confirmation when Arabic text is properly formatted with RTL layout
assumptions.rationale: User interface accessibility standard: inverted or broken bidirectional text impairs medical instruction comprehension.

assumptions.name: Critical Urgency Fast-Track
assumptions.value: Immediate escalation bypasses routine 72h waiting window
assumptions.rationale: High-acuity red flag findings require direct emergency clinical triage rather than asynchronous outreach steps.

assumptions.name: UAE Business Calendar Working Days
assumptions.value: Monday through Friday treated as working days; Saturday and Sunday excluded from SLA countdowns
assumptions.rationale: Aligned with the UAE Federal and Abu Dhabi official working week adopted in January 2022.
